jobs.title: Quantitative Researcher Internship
jobs.summary: Paid part-time internship (typically 1–2 students) at Lynx’s Stockholm headquarters. Work alongside researchers/developers to apply mathematical and programming skills to financial-market projects (signal prototyping, evaluation tooling, data work). Starts with a multi-week on-site introduction then continues part-time during the semester.
jobs.why_relevant: Official Lynx internship focused on quantitative research/development in Stockholm — junior/student-friendly and directly finance/quant focused.

jobs.title: Student Analyst - Market Statistics
jobs.summary: Part-time student role supporting Market Statistics: quantitative analysis, reporting, BI/dashboard work and ad-hoc analyses for Nasdaq’s Nordic markets. Suitable for students in data/quant/finance fields with SQL/Python skills.
jobs.why_relevant: Direct market statistics/data-analytics role inside Nasdaq’s Stockholm team — strong fit for junior data/quant roles.

jobs.title: Student worker in Nasdaq Exchange Services Team
jobs.summary: Part-time student role supporting Exchange Services: verify system prices, calculate settlement prices, support derivatives broker desk and data-quality testing. Requires Python/SQL/VBA and interest in trading.
jobs.why_relevant: Hands-on exchange/trading support and quantitative data tasks — directly relevant for junior trading/quant or market operations careers.

jobs.title: Student Worker to Nasdaq Nordic Listings Team
jobs.summary: Part-time student role supporting Listings: maintaining listings data, client information, go-to-market materials and process improvements — good exposure to market structure and listing operations.
jobs.why_relevant: Listings/data-focused student role at Nasdaq Stockholm — useful on-ramp into market-data, analytics and listings operations.

jobs.title: Open Application - Sweden
jobs.team: Open application — various departments (Investment Banking, Research, Sales / Trading)
jobs.summary: General open application for Stockholm office; suitable for students and junior candidates interested in investment banking, equity/credit research, sales and trading. Lists desired traits (analytical, proactive, good communication in Swedish & English) and invites submissions for Stockholm roles.
jobs.why_relevant: Official Teamtailor open application for Stockholm, targeted at junior candidates across research, sales and trading teams.

jobs.title: Investment Banking Internship VT 2027
jobs.summary: Approximately 10-week internship at DNB Carnegie's Stockholm Investment Banking team (M&A, ECM, DCM). Work on live transactions, financial modelling and pitch materials; aimed at students (min. 3 completed terms).
jobs.why_relevant: Official DNB Carnegie Stockholm internship giving hands-on exposure to corporate finance, valuation and transaction work—appropriate for juniors entering markets/research/analytics.
